task_definition.task_description: Please check whether my checking account is active, then look up AAPL and BTC, place a guarded $250 buy order, get the latest AAPL quote and archive that snapshot in my app as a high-priority “Daily Quote Archive,” and then pull today’s business news. After that, find similar audio products to the Sony WH-1000XM5 in black, pick one recommendation to review, place an order for 1 black Sony WH-1000XM5 with the best available discount using PayPal, and finally send me a high-priority in-app alert when all of that is done.

user_input.query: Please check whether my checking account is active. Then look up AAPL and BTC, and place a guarded buy order for 250 USD. After that, get the latest AAPL quote and archive that snapshot in my app as a high-priority archive titled “Daily Quote Archive” for user_123, then pull today’s business news. Next, find similar audio products to the Sony WH-1000XM5 in black in the audio category, choose one recommendation for me to review, and place an order for 1 black Sony WH-1000XM5 using product_id p_sony_xm5_blk, with items [{product_id: p_sony_xm5_blk, quantity: 1}] and order_quantity 1, using the best available discount and payment_method paypal. Finally, send me a high-priority alert through the app channel when everything is done.
